```python
def _build_narrative_summary(key_params: dict) -> str:
    """Build a narrative workflow summary from key params.
    
    Produces: "modelname at 1024x1024, 30 steps, CFG 7.0, with euler normal"
    """
    parts = []

    model = key_params.get("model", "unknown")
    for suffix in (".safetensors", ".ckpt", ".pt"):
        if model.endswith(suffix):
            model = model[: -len(suffix)]
            break
    parts.append(model)

    resolution = key_params.get("resolution")
    if resolution:
        parts.append(f"at {resolution}")

    steps = key_params.get("steps")
    if steps:
        parts.append(f"{steps} steps")

    cfg = key_params.get("cfg")
    if cfg is not None:
        parts.append(f"CFG {cfg}")

    sampler = key_params.get("sampler_name")
    scheduler = key_params.get("scheduler")
    if sampler:
        sampler_str = sampler
        if scheduler:
            sampler_str = f"{sampler} {scheduler}"
        parts.append(f"with {sampler_str}")

    denoise = key_params.get("denoise")
    if denoise is not None and denoise < 1.0:
        parts.append(f"(denoise {denoise})")

    if len(parts) <= 2:
        return ", ".join(parts)
    return ", ".join(parts[:2]) + ", " + ", ".join(parts[2:])
```

    66→def _load_triggers() -> dict:

    80→def _detect_relevant_knowledge(session_context: dict | None) -> set[str]:
    81→    """Detect which optional knowledge files to load based on context."""
    82→    triggers = set()

    84→    if not session_context:
    85→        return triggers
    86→
    87→    # Check workflow node types
    88→    wf = session_context.get("workflow", {})
    89→    workflow_text = ""
    90→    if wf.get("current_workflow") and isinstance(wf["current_workflow"], dict):
    91→        # He2025: sort to ensure deterministic keyword detection
    92→        class_types = sorted([
    93→            n.get("class_type", "")
    94→            for n in wf["current_workflow"].values()
    95→            if isinstance(n, dict)
    96→        ])
    97→        workflow_text = " ".join(class_types)
    98→
    99→    # Check notes
   100→    notes_text = " ".join(
   101→        n.get("text", "") if isinstance(n, dict) else str(n)
   102→        for n in session_context.get("notes", [])
   103→    )
   104→
   105→    combined = f"{workflow_text} {notes_text}".lower()
   106→
   107→    trigger_defs = _load_triggers()
   108→    for knowledge_file, config in trigger_defs.items():
   109→        keywords = config.get("keywords", [])
   110→        if any(kw.lower() in combined for kw in keywords):
   111→            triggers.add(knowledge_file)

   113→    return triggers

   131→        f"Custom nodes: {CUSTOM_NODES_DIR}\n"
   132→        f"Models: {MODELS_DIR}\n",
   133→    ]
   134→
   135→    # Inject session context (privileged position -- before knowledge)
   136→    if session_context:
   137→        parts.append("\n--- Session Context ---")
   138→        session_name = session_context.get("name", "")
   139→        if session_name:
   140→            parts.append(f"Active session: {session_name}")
   141→
   142→        # Loaded workflow summary
   143→        wf = session_context.get("workflow", {})
   144→        if wf.get("loaded_path"):
   145→            parts.append(
   146→                f"Loaded workflow: {wf['loaded_path']} "
   147→                f"(format: {wf.get('format', '?')})"
   148→            )
   149→            if wf.get("history_depth", 0) > 0:
   150→                parts.append(f"  Patches applied: {wf['history_depth']}")
   151→
   152→        # Session notes (most recent 10)
   153→        notes = session_context.get("notes", [])
   154→        if notes:
   155→            parts.append("User preferences and notes from previous sessions:")
   156→            for note in notes[-10:]:
   157→                text = note.get("text", "") if isinstance(note, dict) else str(note)
   158→                parts.append(f"  - {text}")
   159→        parts.append("")
   160→
   161→    # Proactive recommendations from memory (if outcomes exist)
   162→    if session_context and session_context.get("name"):
   163→        try:
   164→            from .brain.memory import MemoryAgent
   165→            import json as _json
   166→            _mem = MemoryAgent()
   167→            recs_raw = _mem.handle("get_recommendations", {
   168→                "session": session_context["name"],
   169→            })
   170→            recs = _json.loads(recs_raw)
   171→            top_recs = [
   172→                r for r in recs.get("recommendations", [])
   173→                if r.get("confidence", 0) >= 0.7
   174→            ][:3]
   175→            if top_recs:
   176→                parts.append("\n--- Recommendations from Past Sessions ---")
   177→                for rec in top_recs:
   178→                    parts.append(
   179→                        f"  - [{rec.get('category', '?')}] "
   180→                        f"{rec.get('recommendation', '')}"
   181→                    )
   182→                parts.append("")
   183→        except Exception:
   184→            pass  # Memory unavailable -- skip silently
   185→
   186→    # Load core knowledge files (always)
   187→    relevant_extras = _detect_relevant_knowledge(session_context)
   188→    if KNOWLEDGE_DIR.exists():
   189→        for md_file in sorted(KNOWLEDGE_DIR.glob("*.md")):
   190→            stem = md_file.stem
   191→            # Always load core knowledge; load extras only if relevant
   192→            is_core = stem == "comfyui_core"
   193→            is_relevant_extra = stem in relevant_extras
   194→            if is_core or is_relevant_extra:
   195→                try:
   196→                    content = md_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
   197→                    parts.append(f"\n--- {stem} ---\n{content}\n")
   198→                except Exception:
   199→                    pass
   200→
   201→    parts.append(f"\n{_RULES}")
   202→
   203→    return "\n".join(parts)
